title: CI 流水线 DAG 调度模拟：拓扑顺序、最早开始/结束、关键路径长度与最大并行度（确定性整数时钟）
expected_output:
jobs=6
topo_order=lint,build,e2e,test,image,deploy
dag_acyclic=True
  build   start=2  finish=7  dur=5  deps=lint
  deploy  start=14 finish=15 dur=1  deps=image,e2e
  e2e     start=7  finish=13 dur=6  deps=build
  image   start=11 finish=14 dur=3  deps=test
  lint    start=0  finish=2  dur=2  deps=-
  test    start=7  finish=11 dur=4  deps=build
makespan_min=15
critical_path=lint->build->test->image->deploy
critical_path_len=15
max_parallelism=2
sum_job_minutes=21
serial_would_take=21
speedup_pct=28.6
code:
JOBS = {
    "lint":   {"deps": [], "min": 2},
    "build":  {"deps": ["lint"], "min": 5},
    "test":   {"deps": ["build"], "min": 4},
    "e2e":    {"deps": ["build"], "min": 6},
    "image":  {"deps": ["test"], "min": 3},
    "deploy": {"deps": ["image", "e2e"], "min": 1},
}


def topo(jobs):
    indeg = {n: len(j["deps"]) for n, j in jobs.items()}
    ready = sorted(n for n in indeg if indeg[n] == 0)
    order = []
    while ready:
        n = ready.pop(0)
        order.append(n)
        for m, j in jobs.items():
            if n in j["deps"]:
                indeg[m] -= 1
                if indeg[m] == 0:
                    ready.append(m)
        ready.sort()
    return order, len(order) == len(jobs)


order, ok = topo(JOBS)
start, finish = {}, {}
for n in order:
    s = max([finish[d] for d in JOBS[n]["deps"]], default=0)
    start[n] = s
    finish[n] = s + JOBS[n]["min"]

makespan = max(finish.values())

# 关键路径回溯：从最晚结束的 job 反向取结束时间最大的依赖
end_job = min(n for n in finish if finish[n] == makespan)
path, cur = [end_job], end_job
while JOBS[cur]["deps"]:
    cand = sorted(JOBS[cur]["deps"], key=lambda d: (-finish[d], d))
    cur = cand[0]
    path.append(cur)
path.reverse()

# 最大并行度：按整数分钟扫描区间
events = []
for n in JOBS:
    events.append((start[n], 1))
    events.append((finish[n], -1))
events.sort()
running = best = 0
for _, d in events:
    running += d
    best = max(best, running)

print("jobs=%d" % len(JOBS))
print("topo_order=%s" % ",".join(order))
print("dag_acyclic=%s" % ok)
for n in sorted(JOBS):
    print("  %-7s start=%-2d finish=%-2d dur=%-2d deps=%s"
          % (n, start[n], finish[n], JOBS[n]["min"], ",".join(JOBS[n]["deps"]) or "-"))
print("makespan_min=%d" % makespan)
print("critical_path=%s" % "->".join(path))
print("critical_path_len=%d" % sum(JOBS[n]["min"] for n in path))
print("max_parallelism=%d" % best)
print("sum_job_minutes=%d" % sum(j["min"] for j in JOBS.values()))
print("serial_would_take=%d" % sum(j["min"] for j in JOBS.values()))
print("speedup_pct=%.1f" % (round(100.0 * (sum(j["min"] for j in JOBS.values()) - makespan) / sum(j["min"] for j in JOBS.values()), 1)))
